title: Infinite families of Diophantine quadruples in $\mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{-2}]$ in the remaining exceptional congruence classes
summary: We continue the study of $D(z)$-quadruples in the ring $\mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{-2}]$. Motivated by the earlier classification due to the authors and by the subsequent partial results for the remaining families, we consider the exceptional congruence classes arising in the forms $24a+5+(12b+6)\sqrt{-2}$, $24a+2+(12b+6)\sqrt{-2}$, and $48a+44+(24b+12)\sqrt{-2}$.
